admission_rules.training: Only explicit official/public train partitions are eligible; benchmark/eval rows remain denied.
admission_rules.split: Keep source-local parent/task/slot disjointness and bind source revisions before training.
admission_rules.native: A WebGPU capability receipt cannot substitute for an emulator, VM, browser, MCP server, or independent verifier.
admission_rules.safety: Safety and prompt-injection suites require action-history/state execution; text policy projections are diagnostics.

claim_boundary: This is a source/method inventory, not a benchmark result or publication approval.
